messages:
Evan Cho: FYI Novea Finance flagged invoice INV-9178 1
Evan Cho: they ran a DR drill yesterday and got ~5k overage charge for Dedicated burst. Can ops / billing sanity-check?
Maya Patel: sending to billing ops. Evan, can you paste the invoice line and any meter ids?
Evan Cho: invoice excerpt:
  LineItem: DEDICATED_BURST
  Period: 2026-04-02
  ReservedCommit: 800,000 token-hours
  BurstUsage: 1,300,000 token-hours
  Charge: $9,200
  Invoice: INV-9178
  Account: novea-prod
Zara Khan (Novea): correct. We did a failover test to validate our multi-region DR runbook. It lasted ~35 minutes but traffic spiked because proxies warmed up. We assumed commit covered test load.
billing-bot: Alert: Dedicated burst threshold exceeded for account novea-prod at 2026-04-02T14:12:40Z 1 estimate: $9,200
Priya Rao: action: 1) pull per-node token counts for 2026-04-02 13:45-15:00 UTC; 2) map to meter IDs and invoice hash; 3) check account's historic 30d cross-region events. Opening BILL-2026-994.
Samir Patel (RevOps): Novea is on an annual reserved commit with a DR allowance note in their SOW but not explicit about test-induced bursts. We can consider a one-time operational credit if this is a scheduled test and they notified us in advance. Did they notify support?
Zara Khan (Novea): we filed a ticket with support (SUP-64521) at 2026-04-01 11:05 UTC notifying of an upcoming drill, cc'ed the AE. Not sure if that meets the "advance notice" criteria.
Maya Patel: please attach the SUP ticket to BILL-2026-994. Policy: scheduled DRs don't automatically waive burst charges unless the customer buys additional warm capacity or we pre-authorize the test window. However, we have a discretionary operational credit for first-time scheduled drills with notice. Recommend provisional credit = 50% of invoice ($4,600) pending recon.
Evan Cho: I'm +1 to provisional 50%. We'll record as goodwill and note this in the invoice memo if approved. Priya, please include a short recon doc with meter mapping and whether proxies caused amplification (i.e., multiple nodes replaying requests).
Priya Rao: pulling logs now. Found node list: node-eu-prim, node-eu-proxy-a, node-usw-standby. Uploading /exports/novea/2026-04-02-usage.csv to the ticket. Also checking prior 30-day pattern for similar spikes.

```
2026-04-02T14:06:12Z,node-eu-prim,250000 tokens
2026-04-02T14:06:15Z,node-eu-proxy-a,260000 tokens
2026-04-02T14:12:43Z,node-usw-standby,310000 tokens
```

billing-bot: Attached export: /exports/novea/2026-04-02-usage.csv (processed). Meter IDs: node-eu-prim,node-eu-proxy-a,node-usw-standby.
Samir Patel (RevOps): if proxies are duplicating traffic during warmup that's an ops config issue; we can offer a joint config review and a one-time 50% operational credit, but we should add a clause to the renewal MSA clarifying scheduled tests. I'll draft an amendment and loop legal if Novea accepts.
Zara Khan (Novea): appreciate that. We'll take the config review. Please confirm provisional credit and timing for invoice adjustment.
Maya Patel: provisional credit of $4,600 approved by finance pending final meter reconciliation. Priya, recon due EOD +48h. If reconciliation shows unusual amplification or repeated tests <30 days apart, escalate to legal. Otherwise we'll apply credit and issue corrected invoice.

Evan Cho: noted. I'll inform AE and CS to schedule the config session. Thanks all :thumbsup:
